name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering (CPU-Sorted, Instanced)
aliases: Instanced Gaussian Splatting with Back-to-Front Sorting
definition: A display-only renderer for trained 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes that projects 3D Gaussian distributions into 2D screen-space quads, sorts them by camera-space depth on the CPU, and renders them using instanced drawing with standard alpha blending.
